text: ok and then one more thing is it not possible to force all the uv verts to grid snap out of the gate. its incredibly annoying that it doesnt
resolution: Generated UV layouts now emit grid-snapped corners: in paint_islands.zig's emission pass, every corner rounds to the nearest whole texel within its island rect (clamp [0,w]), replacing the old half-texel inset + unroll fp fractions that made hand editing in the UV workspace miserable. Safety checked before building: model_paint's fill/tint paths already expand strokes into the 2-texel pad gutter and clamp at the island rect, so border-exact corners sample cleanly under linear filtering. Guard: a pre-pass detects islands where snapping would collapse any triangle (sub-texel slivers) and those keep the legacy inset corners — the decision is island-wide so shared corners stay bit-coincident and the req_3879 continuity rule never splits a chart over it. Authored/imported UVs (reconstruction lane) are user data and are never quantized. Cube law test extended: every generated corner must be integer-valued. 13/13 paint_islands, 55/55 model-paint, 166/166 mesh-edit. Rebuild + Remake Atlas to get grid-true corners.
